theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂ with
  | refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  | par ha hb ihx ihy =>
      cases h₂ with
      | refl => exact ⟨_, .refl _, .par ha hb⟩
      | par hc hd =>
          obtain ⟨c, h₁, h₂⟩ := ihx hc
          obtain ⟨d, h₃, h₄⟩ := ihy hd
          exact ⟨_, .par h₁ h₃, .par h₂ h₄⟩
      | red_I => cases ha; exact ⟨_, .red_I .., hb⟩
      | red_K => obtain ⟨_, hc, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha; exact ⟨_, .red_K .., hc⟩
      | red_S => obtain ⟨_, _, h₁, h₂, rfl⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha; exact ⟨_, .red_S .., .par (.par h₁ hb) (.par h₂ hb)⟩
  | red_I => cases h₂ with
      | par hc hd => cases hc; exact ⟨_, hd, .red_I _⟩
      | _ => exact ⟨_, .refl _, by constructor⟩
  | red_K => cases h₂ with
      | par hc hd => obtain ⟨_, hl, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ hc; exact ⟨_, hl, .red_K ..⟩
      | _ => exact ⟨_, .refl _, by constructor⟩
  | red_S => cases h₂ with

cells.selected_proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h i
  have key : ∀ x y : Fin 9 → ℤ, ∀ j : Fin 9,
      digits_to_num (fun k => if k = j then x k else y k)
        = digits_to_num y + (x j - y j) * 10 ^ j.1 := by
    intro x y j
    have h1 : ∀ k : Fin 9, ∀ a b w : ℤ, (if k = j then a else b) * w = b * w + (if k = j then (a - b) * w else 0) := by
      intro k a b w
      exact if h : k = j then by simp only [if_pos h]; ring else by simp only [if_neg h, add_zero]
    rw [hdigits_to_num]
    simp only [h1, Finset.sum_add_distrib, Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
  have hA : ∀ x y : Fin 9 → ℤ, relation x y → ∀ j : Fin 9,
      7 ∣ digits_to_num x + (y j - x j) * 10 ^ j.1 :=
    fun x y r j => (key y x j) ▸ ((hrelation x y).mp r).2 j
  have hsum : ∑ j : Fin 9, (digits_to_num d + (e j - d j) * 10 ^ j.1) - 7 * digits_to_num d
      = digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e := by
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    simp only [hdigits_to_num, sub_mul, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ,
      Fintype.card_fin, Int.nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat]
    ring
  have hDE : 7 ∣ digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e :=
    hsum ▸ dvd_sub (Finset.dvd_sum fun j _ => hA d e h.1 j) (dvd_mul_right 7 (digits_to_num d))
  have hc : 7 ∣ (d i - f i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by
    have h9 : digits_to_num d + digits_to_num e
        - (digits_to_num d + (e i - d i) * 10 ^ i.1 + (digits_to_num e + (f i - e i) * 10 ^ i.1))
        = (d i - f i) * 10 ^ i.1 := by ring
    rw [← h9]
    exact dvd_sub hDE (dvd_add (hA d e h.1 i) (hA e f h.2 i))
  exact (by norm_num : IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) (10 : ℤ)).pow_right.dvd_of_dvd_mul_right hc

lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  have key (u v : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
      ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF u * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF v) =
      ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF u * ofCrAnListF v)) := by
    let l₁ := (List.takeWhile (fun c => ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel φ c) (crAnTimeOrderList (u ++ v))) ++
      List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) u
    let l₂ := List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) v ++
      List.filter (fun c => crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ ¬ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ)
        (crAnTimeOrderList (u ++ v))
    have h1 : crAnTimeOrderList (u ++ φ :: ψ :: v) = l₁ ++ φ :: ψ :: l₂ := by
      rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show u ++ φ :: ψ :: v = u ++ [φ, ψ] ++ v by simp,
        insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ u [φ, ψ] v (by simp_all)]
      simp only [crAnTimeOrderList, l₁, l₂, List.singleton_append, List.append_assoc,
        List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    have h2 : crAnTimeOrderList (u ++ ψ :: φ :: v) = l₁ ++ ψ :: φ :: l₂ := by
      rw [crAnTimeOrderList, show u ++ ψ :: φ :: v = u ++ [ψ, φ] ++ v by simp,
        insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ u [ψ, φ] v (by simp_all)]
      simp only [crAnTimeOrderList, l₁, l₂, List.singleton_append, List.append_assoc,
        List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    have h3 : crAnTimeOrderList (u ++ v) = l₁ ++ l₂ := by
      rw [crAnTimeOrderList, insertionSort_of_takeWhile_filter 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ u v]
      simp only [crAnTimeOrderList, l₁, l₂, List.append_assoc, List.cons_append, List.nil_append]
    have hs : crAnTimeOrderSign (u ++ ψ :: φ :: v) = crAnTimeOrderSign (u ++ φ :: ψ :: v) :=
      (crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ u v).symm
    have hp (u v : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp) :
        ofCrAnListF u * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF v =
        ofCrAnListF (u ++ φ :: ψ :: v) -
        𝓢(𝓕 |>ₛ φ, 𝓕 |>ₛ ψ) • ofCrAnListF (u ++ ψ :: φ :: v) := by
      rw [superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton]
      simp only [mul_sub, sub_mul, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, Algebra.smul_mul_assoc,
        ← ofCrAnListF_append, List.cons_append, List.nil_append, List.append_assoc]
    have hL : ι 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF u * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF v) =
        crAnTimeOrderSign (u ++ φ :: ψ :: v) •
          ι (ofCrAnListF l₁ * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * ofCrAnListF l₂) := by
      rw [hp]
      simp only [map_sub, map_smul, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, hs, h1, h2]
      rw [hp, map_sub, map_smul]
      simp only [smul_sub, smul_smul, mul_comm]
    have hR : ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF u * ofCrAnListF v)) =
        crAnTimeOrderSign (u ++ v) •
          ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * (ofCrAnListF l₁ * ofCrAnListF l₂)) := by
      rw [← ofCrAnListF_append, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, Algebra.mul_smul_comm, map_smul, h3,
        ofCrAnListF_append]
    rw [hL, hR]
    simp only [map_mul]
    rw [Subalgebra.mem_center_iff.mp (ι_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF_mem_center φ ψ), mul_assoc]
    by_cases hq : (𝓕 |>ₛ φ) = (𝓕 |>ₛ ψ)
    · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ hq.symm, ← crAnTimeOrderSign]
    · simp only [ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq, zero_mul, smul_zero]
  apply Submodule.span_induction₂ (R := ℂ) (s := Set.range ofCrAnListFBasis)

        ι 𝓣ᶠ(x * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * y) =
          ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(x * y)))
  · rintro x y ⟨u, rfl⟩ ⟨v, rfl⟩
    simpa only [ofListBasis_eq_ofList] using key u v
  · rintro y _
    simp only [zero_mul, mul_zero, map_zero]
  · rintro x _
    simp only [mul_zero, map_zero]
  · rintro x y z _ _ _ hpx hpy
    simp only [add_mul, mul_add, map_add, hpx, hpy]
  · rintro x y z _ _ _ hpx hpy

  · rintro r x y _ _ hpx

lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  ext y
  by_contra hy
  let p := fun x => ⟪f x, f y⟫_ℝ
  have hc : Continuous p := by fun_prop
  have h0 : 0 < p y := lt_of_le_of_ne' real_inner_self_nonneg' (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hy)
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hin⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff.mp (hc.continuousAt.eventually (lt_mem_nhds h0))
  let φ : ContDiffBump y := ⟨d / 2, d, half_pos hd, half_lt_self hd⟩
  have key := hg _ (IsTestFunction.smul_right (g := fun _ => f y) ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const)
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at key
  have hn0 : ∀ x, 0 ≤ φ x * p x := by
    intro x
    by_cases hx : dist x y < d
    · exact mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hin hx).le
    · rw [φ.zero_of_le_dist (not_lt.mp hx), zero_mul]
  have hI : 0 < ∫ x, φ x * p x ∂μ :=
    (φ.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero
      φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right hn0
      (mul_pos (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self hd)) h0).ne'
  exact hI.ne' key

lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hc : ContDiff ℝ 2 A := hA.of_le (by decide)
  have hd : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le (by decide)
  have hJd : Differentiable ℝ J := hJ.differentiable (by decide)
  have hcμ : 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ = 𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ :=
    by rw [FreeSpace.c_sq, div_mul_eq_mul_div, mul_div_mul_right _ _ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]
  have hE : ∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 2 (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) :=
    fun j => electricField_apply_contDiff_space hd t
  have hB : ∀ j, Differentiable ℝ (fun s => ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) :=
    fun j => Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff A hd (j, i)) x
  have h1 : ∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i) = fun s =>
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * J.currentDensity 𝓕.c s x i := by
    funext s
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time hc x),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h s, mul_comm 𝓕.μ₀ 𝓕.ε₀, ← FreeSpace.c_sq, hcμ]
  have lin : ∀ f K : Time → ℝ, DifferentiableAt ℝ f t → DifferentiableAt ℝ K t → ∀ a b : ℝ,
      ∂ₜ (fun s => a * f s - b * K s) t = a * ∂ₜ f t - b * ∂ₜ K t := by
    intro f K hf hK a b
    rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub (hf.const_mul a) (hK.const_mul b), fderiv_const_mul hf,
      fderiv_const_mul hK]
    rfl
  have hsum : ∂ₜ (fun s => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.magneticFieldMatrix 𝓕.c s · (j, i)) x) t
      = ∑ j, ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x -
          ∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x := by
    rw [Time.deriv_fun_sum Finset.univ _ fun j _ => (hB j).differentiableAt,
      ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    congr
    funext j
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff A hd (j, i)),
      funext (fun y => time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A hc t y j i)]
    show ∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i) - ∂[i] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x = _
    rw [Space.deriv_sub _ _ (Space.deriv_differentiable (hE i) j) (Space.deriv_differentiable (hE j) i), Space.deriv_commute _ (hE j)]
    rfl
  have hρ : (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) =
      fun y => 1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t y :=
    funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1.trans
      (by ring)
  have hpull : ∂[i] (fun y => ∑ j, ∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) y) x
      = ∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x := by
    rw [Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, fderiv_fun_sum fun j _ => (Space.deriv_differentiable (hE j) j).differentiableAt]
    simp only [FunLike.coe_sum, Finset.sum_apply]
    rfl
  have h4 : ∑ j, ∂[i] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j)) x =
      1 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x := by
    rw [← hpull, hρ, Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis,
      fderiv_const_mul (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space hJd t).differentiableAt]
    rfl
  rw [h1, lin _ _ (Differentiable.differentiableAt (Differentiable.fun_sum fun j _ => hB j))
    ((LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time hJd x i).differentiableAt) _ _,
    hsum, h4]
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv, one_div]

    right

theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  let f : ℕ → Fin 4 → ℤ := fun n k => u (n + k)
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, h_eq⟩ :=
    Set.Finite.exists_lt_map_eq_of_forall_mem (t := Set.pi univ fun _ : Fin 4 => Set.Icc B T)
      (fun n k _ => hB (n + k)) (Set.Finite.pi fun _ => Set.finite_Icc B T)
  have hΦ n : (u (n + 4) : ℝ) = (f n 3 + f n 2 + f n 1 * f n 0) / (f n 3 * f n 2 + f n 1 + f n 0) :=
    (hu (n + 4) (Nat.le_add_left 4 n)).1
  have key : ∀ k, f (i + k) = f (j + k) := by
    refine Nat.rec h_eq fun k ih => ?_
    have h4 : u (i + k + 4) = u (j + k + 4) := by rw [← Int.cast_inj (α := ℝ), hΦ, hΦ, ih]
    funext m
    fin_cases m
    · exact congrFun ih 1
    · exact congrFun ih 2
    · exact congrFun ih 3
    · exact h4
  refine' ⟨i, j - i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, fun n hn => ?_⟩
  rw [← Nat.add_sub_cancel' hn, Nat.add_right_comm i, Nat.add_sub_cancel' (Nat.le_of_lt hij)]
  exact (congrFun (key (n - i)) 0).symm

theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intros P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let fiberMap := qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩ 1 h_i_succ_lt y
  let P₀ := evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  let P₁ := oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs
  have h_poly : P_i_plus_1 = Polynomial.C (1 - r_chal) * P₀ + Polynomial.C r_chal * P₁ := by
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, new_coeffs, P₀, P₁, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib, mul_sum, Polynomial.C_add,
      Polynomial.C_mul, mul_add, add_mul, mul_assoc]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun _ _ => rfl
  have h_split (k : Fin 2) :
      f_i (fiberMap k) = P₀.eval y.val + (fiberMap k).val * P₁.eval y.val := by
    have hq : (qMap 𝔽q β ⟨i, by omega⟩).eval (fiberMap k).val = y := by
      have h := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i (steps := 1) (by omega)
        (x := fiberMap k) (y := y) ⟨k, rfl⟩
      rw [h, iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i (by omega) (fiberMap k)]
    simp only [evaluation_poly_split_identity 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate ⟨i, by omega⟩ coeffs,
      f_i, P_i, P₀, P₁, Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X,
      Polynomial.eval_comp, hq]
  have hx₁ : (fiberMap 1).val = 1 + (fiberMap 0).val := by
    have hf (k : Fin 2) := qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i (by omega) y k
    simp only [fiberMap, Fin.isValue, hf 1, hf 0, Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul,
      one_smul, zero_smul, add_right_inj, zero_add,
      get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1, (show Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 0 = 0 from rfl),
      (show Fin2ToF2 𝔽q 1 = 1 from rfl)]
  show _ * ((1 - r_chal) * _ - r_chal) + _ * (r_chal - (1 - r_chal) * _) = _
  rw [h_poly, h_split 0, h_split 1, hx₁]
  simp only [Polynomial.eval_add, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_C]
  ring
